catches: In-person at Cambridge Judge Business School, Cambridge UK - local availability matters
Variable payments depend on your decisions and other participants' decisions

Session durations are not stated on the page

eligibility: Members of the public who sign up for advertised experiments at the Cambridge Judge Experimental Computer Laboratory
notes: Standing experimental participation program of Cambridge Judge Business School (University of Cambridge). Payment is either a fixed lump sum or a £3 show-up fee plus variable pay tied to decisions. The £10/hour is a stated average across payment types, so the honest range uses the £3 show-up fee as the floor and the £10/hr average as the top. GBP converted at 1.334 (Sept 22-23, 2026) and documented in payout_value_note.
numeric_basis: payout from official terms (£3 show-up fee floor; £10/hr stated average; converted at 1 GBP = 1.334 USD, Sept 22-23 2026); time: typical experimental session estimate since page does not state durations
payout_quote: For studies conducted online or in the Experimental Computer Laboratory, participants can also be paid using Amazon and other vouchers, or via the Cambridge Casual Worker System (CCWS). After the experiment is over, participants are paid. There are 2 major types of payment: fixed payments or a combination of fixed and variable payments. The fixed payment is a lump sum the experimenter pays equally to all participants. If a combination of fixed and variable payments is used, a participant receives a fixed payment of £3 as show-up fee and will earn a variable payment depending on the participant's decisions and those of other participants. The average for both types of payment is £10 per hour.
payout_value_note: £3 show-up fee and £10/hr stated average converted at 1 GBP = 1.334 USD (mid-market, Sept 22-23 2026) = $4.00-$13.34; variable pay depends on decisions.

Sign up for an experimental session

Receive payment after the experiment (fixed lump sum or £3 show-up fee + variable pay)
